result:
The decisive mistake was the Orchestrator's instruction at step 5. The Bing results had already shown only current Ensembl pages (release 113, the ROS_Cfam_1.0 assembly), which are not the files from May 2020. Instead of looking for the assembly in use at that date (CanFam3.1, hosted at the Broad Institute), the Orchestrator directed WebSurfer to the Ensembl genome browser 113 page. That sent the search toward a wrong, post-2020 resource. The Orchestrator then compounded the error at step 9 by declaring the request satisfied without checking the date.

AGENT: Orchestrator (thought)
STEP: 5
